zh: 中国队在冬奥会上夺得短道速滑混合接力金牌。
en: China won gold in the mixed team relay in short track speed skating at the Winter Olympics.

zh: 城市马拉松报名人数突破十万，中签率不到三成。
en: Over one hundred thousand people signed up for the city marathon; fewer than thirty percent got in.

zh: 电子竞技成为亚运会正式项目，职业选手有了更大的舞台。
en: Esports is now an official Asian Games event, giving professional players a bigger stage.

zh: 足球联赛恢复主客场制，球迷终于回到了看台。
en: The football league returned to home-and-away games, and fans are finally back in the stands.

zh: 全民健身器材进了社区，大爷大妈也练起了引体向上。
en: Fitness equipment has entered communities, and seniors are trying pull-ups.

zh: 这位游泳小将打破了自己保持的亚洲纪录。
en: The young swimmer broke the Asian record she once held herself.

zh: 篮球世界杯预选赛，主队在加时赛完成绝杀。
en: In the basketball World Cup qualifier, the home team won at the buzzer in overtime.

zh: 瑜伽和飞盘成了都市年轻人的新宠。
en: Yoga and frisbee are the new favorites of young city dwellers.

zh: 体育馆免费时段一到，羽毛球场总是供不应求。
en: The moment free court time opens, the badminton courts are fully booked.

zh: 女排姑娘们苦战五局，逆转拿下了关键一战。
en: The women's volleyball team battled through five sets and came back to win.

zh: 这位短跑运动员因伤退赛，遗憾告别本届奥运会。
en: The sprinter withdrew due to injury, missing out on this year's Olympics.

zh: 冰雪运动南展西扩，室内滑雪场在南方城市落地。
en: Ice and snow sports are spreading south, with indoor ski resorts opening in southern cities.

zh: 村级篮球联赛火爆全网，现场观众挤满了球场四周。
en: A village basketball league went viral online, drawing packed crowds.

zh: 跑步软件的记录显示，他今年已经跑了九百公里。
en: His running app shows he has covered nine hundred kilometers this year.

zh: 主教练在赛后发布会上说，胜利属于整个团队。
en: The head coach said after the match that the victory belonged to the whole team.

zh: 体育课改要求中小学生每天锻炼不少于一小时。
en: The curriculum reform requires at least one hour of daily exercise for primary and secondary students.

zh: 骑行热潮带火了装备销售，头盔一度卖到断货。
en: The cycling boom boosted equipment sales, and helmets sold out for a time.

zh: 这位乒乓球小将首次参加世乒赛就闯进了决赛。
en: In her first World Table Tennis Championships, the young player reached the final.

zh: 残奥会运动员的拼搏精神感动了无数观众。
en: The grit of the Paralympic athletes moved audiences everywhere.

zh: 广场舞大赛决赛在市中心广场举行，几十支队伍同场竞技。
en: The square dance final was held on the central plaza, with dozens of teams competing.
